hikes.name: Maple Pass Loop
hikes.blurb: The North Cascades' classic ridge loop, high above Lake Ann, golden with larches in early autumn.

hikes.name: Cascade Pass and Sahale Arm
hikes.blurb: Switchbacks to a famous pass under hanging glaciers, then up a meadow ridge to the edge of the Sahale Glacier.

hikes.name: Cascade Pass
hikes.blurb: A steady climb to a meadow pass with Johannesburg's ice walls across the valley.

hikes.name: Blue Lake
hikes.blurb: An easy climb through larch to a turquoise lake under the spires of the Early Winters group.

hikes.name: Hidden Lake Peaks Lookout
hikes.blurb: Meadows, then boulders and snow to a lookout cabin over a frozen lake and a sea of jagged peaks.

hikes.name: Cutthroat Pass
hikes.blurb: Past a lake under Cutthroat Peak and up to a granite pass looking over a basin of larches.

hikes.name: Easy Pass
hikes.blurb: Not easy at all: a steep scramble to a pass with the Fisher Creek basin and Mt Logan below.

hikes.name: Cedar Falls
hikes.blurb: A gentle forest walk to a falls cutting through a granite slot near Mazama.

hikes.name: Tiffany Mountain
hikes.blurb: Open slopes in the dry Okanogan high country to a summit with a view from the Cascades to Canada.

hikes.name: Rainy Lake
hikes.blurb: A paved, flat stroll to a lake under a waterfall and a hanging glacier.

hikes.name: Ladder Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Across a footbridge behind the Newhalem powerhouse to a falls tumbling through a rock gorge, lit at night.

hikes.name: Thornton Lakes
hikes.blurb: Up an old logging road and steep trail to a granite-rimmed lake below Trappers Peak.

hikes.name: Thunder Knob
hikes.blurb: An easy climb to rocky viewpoints over the startling green of Diablo Lake.

hikes.name: Sourdough Mountain Lookout
hikes.blurb: One of the steepest trails around, 5,000 feet straight up to a lookout over Diablo and Ross Lakes.

hikes.name: Twisp Pass
hikes.blurb: Up the head of the Twisp River to a pass looking into the North Cascades park.

hikes.name: Grasshopper Pass
hikes.blurb: South on the Pacific Crest Trail from the state's highest road along open, larch-spotted ridges.

hikes.name: Black Peak
hikes.blurb: From Rainy Pass Trailhead, an 11.2-mile round trip to the top of Black Peak (8,902 ft), with about 5,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Pierce Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Sourdough Trailhead, a 13.2-mile round trip to the top of Pierce Mountain (5,994 ft), with about 6,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mix-up Peak
hikes.blurb: From Cascade Pass Trailhead, a 9.1-mile round trip to the top of Mix-up Peak (6,305 ft), with about 2,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Windy Peak
hikes.blurb: From Chewuch Trailhead, a 10.0-mile round trip to the top of Windy Peak (8,322 ft), with about 2,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lexington Tower
hikes.blurb: From Blue Lake Trailhead, a 4.6-mile round trip to the top of Lexington Tower (7,542 ft), with about 2,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Scatter Lake
hikes.blurb: From Scatter Creek Trailhead, a 9.3-mile round trip to Scatter Lake, with about 3,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Monogram Lake
hikes.blurb: From Lookout Mountain Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to Monogram Lake, with about 4,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wing Lake
hikes.blurb: From Rainy Pass Trailhead, a 9.2-mile round trip to Wing Lake, with about 3,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lookout Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Lookout Mountain Trailhead, a 9.0-mile round trip to the top of Lookout Mountain (5,700 ft), with about 4,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Stiletto Peak
hikes.blurb: From Bridge Creek Trailhead, a 10.8-mile round trip to the top of Stiletto Peak (7,190 ft), with about 4,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Louis Lake
hikes.blurb: From South Creek Trailhead, a 9.9-mile round trip to Louis Lake, with about 2,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Driveway Butte
hikes.blurb: From Driveway Butte Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to the top of Driveway Butte (5,968 ft), with about 3,050 feet of climbing.
